actions.target: Fix gripper_joint frozen constant in V58 recording pipeline
actions.current_problem: V58 state[7] (gripper_joint) is frozen at -0.042 across ALL 18,701 frames (std=9.6e-9). Oracle actions vary (-1.0 to +1.0) but state never updates. drawer_robot_env.py has the fix, drawer_robot_env_lerobot.py does NOT.
actions.evidence: V58 eval: pretrained=0%, finetuned=0%, but eef_motion=4.13m (model learns motion but not gripper). Gripper_joint frozen → state tokenizer produces identical tokens → zero gripper signal.
actions.solution: Apply the same continuous gripper conversion fix from drawer_robot_env.py to drawer_robot_env_lerobot.py → _state_vector(). Formula: (j9+j10)/2 * 1.075 - 0.042 where PyBullet finger_pos ∈ [0.0, 0.04].
actions.reason: CRITICAL: All V58 training data (18,701 frames) has frozen gripper_joint. MINT's state tokenizer receives zero gripper information. This is the L2 observation bug that makes learning impossible.

actions.target: Fix near-white images in V58 dataset
actions.current_problem: V58 rendered images: mean=[0.976, 0.976, 0.976], std=[0.003, 0.003, 0.003] — near-white, zero useful visual information. LIBERO images: mean=[0.414, 0.371, 0.329], std=[0.252, 0.247, 0.241].
actions.evidence: V58 train.log: image mean ~0.976 across all frames. Vision encoder pretrained on LIBERO realistic scenes cannot learn from white noise.
actions.solution: Verify PyBullet ERendered is capturing actual scene geometry. Check camera configuration, lighting, and renderer backend (ER_TINY_RENDERER vs ERendering). Add visual debugging to capture and save sample frames.
actions.reason: CRITICAL: Vision encoder receives near-white images → cannot infer gripper state or scene structure → MINT outputs random gripper actions → 0% success.

actions.target: Audit and fix observation.state[8] format to match LIBERO real semantics
actions.current_problem_detail: Infinigen state format: [eef_pos(3) + eef_quat(4) + gripper_binary{0,1}] — MINT processor_mint.py digitizes state[7] to 256 bins → text token. LIBERO state[7]: continuous joint position (min=-0.041, max=0.001, std=0.013). Infinigen {0,1} lands in completely wrong bins → MINT state tokenizer confused → gripper never closes (ever_attached=false).
